item.title: Iran targets commercial ships, oil infrastructure as Israel expands strikes to central Beirut
Air Transat charging more for flights to Europe as jet fuel prices weigh on airlines
item.summary: Air Transat is charging more for flights to Europe as the soaring cost of jet fuel — triggered by an oil crisis that has emerged from the war in the Middle East — weighs on Canadian and international airlines.

item.title: Russia accuses Britain of helping Ukraine in missile strike that killed 6
item.summary: The Kremlin on Wednesday accused British specialists of involvement in a deadly Ukrainian strike on the Russian city of ‌Bryansk that used British Storm Shadow missiles and said it would take Britain's role "into account."

item.title: Why would a desalination plant be a military target? | About That
item.summary: Andrew Chang explains how the war in the Middle East is threatening critical freshwater infrastructure in the region. Images provided by The Canadian Press, Reuters and Getty Images

item.title: How Trump's timeline for the war on Iran keeps shifting, and why that matters
item.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump and his secretary of war have given multiple and often contradictory descriptions of how long they expect the military operation against Iran to continue.

item.title: Canada raises alarm about escalating violence in Lebanon
item.summary: The Canadian government said Tuesday it is alarmed by the escalation of violence and attacks in Lebanon, as the war in the Middle East expands. It called on all sides to uphold humanitarian law.

item.title: How high will the U.S.-Israel war with Iran push gas prices? | About That

item.title: Why Trump can't afford to brush off the Iran war's economic impact
item.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump is trying to downplay the effect of the Iran war on the domestic economy even as American drivers are already feeling the impact on their wallets every time they fill up their cars and trucks.

item.title: Trump says war in Iran could be over soon, but U.S. hasn't 'won enough' yet
item.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump hinted on Monday that the war in the Middle East could be over soon — though not this week, he specified — even as hardliners pledged loyalty to their new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.

item.title: Video appears to contradict Trump claim that U.S. wasn't responsible for deadly Minab school blast
item.summary: New footage shows what an expert investigative group says is likely an American Tomahawk missile hitting a compound in southern Iran, metres from the school where a deadly unclaimed blast killed more than 165 people at the start of the war raging in the Middle East.
